add_en: It covers opto warmth, VCA punch and FET bite.
add_es: Cubre calidez opto, pegada VCA y mordiente FET.

add_en: Four assignable faders and APHEX processing keep every source under control.
Its figure-8 pattern spans 20Hz–20kHz.
add_es: Su patrón figura-8 cubre 20 Hz–20 kHz con margen de 135 dB.

add_en: Randomization adds organic imperfections, from subtle tape warmth to full degradation.
The split-coil delivers thick, mid-forward punch that sits under guitars without fighting them.
The short scale keeps stretches painless, and guitar shapes transfer instantly.
add_es: El tiro corto evita estiramientos dolorosos.

add_en: Round P warmth and J bridge bite blend into one sweet spot.
Dual expression inputs and full MIDI control an entire rig around its captures.
PURE, JFET and ACTIVE modes shape tone before any plugin loads.
Its channels are not frequency-coordinatable for festivals.
add_es: Sus canales no se coordinan en frecuencia para festivales densos.

add_en: Composition, tracking and spatial mixing share the same window.
add_es: Composición, grabación y mezcla conviven en una ventana.

add_en: Bass rolls off near 49 Hz, so bass-heavy genres may want a subwoofer.
Sounds are built like separate stompboxes, with an effects loop.
add_es: Los sonidos se construyen como con pedales sueltos.

add_en: Its 61 touch-sensitive keys suit solo practice and small gigs with auto-accompaniment.
It suits small rooms and players wanting a realistic feel without a cabinet.
A null directly behind the capsule means monitors belong elsewhere.
The three-saddle bridge holds intonation well for a working band, though limits remain.
Dropping the headstock shrinks overall length dramatically while the strings keep familiar tension.
Both pickups give a scooped slap tone.
add_es: Ambas pastillas dan el slap con medios recortados.

add_en: The fixed cabinet gives it the presence of a small upright.
Memory and manual modes recall presets or toggle effects like single pedals.
Its 200-plus rhythms use 16 kits; it weighs 2.4 kg.
The 5-inch cone and 1-inch dome reach 54 Hz–30 kHz for honest low-end reporting.
Triple-sensor keys support splits, layers and Live Sets, with AWM2 and FM voices.
Nutube warmth and balanced XLR outs with ground lift simplify house feeds.
The five-way Performance EQ reshapes mids and lows for each technique.
